reason: An AbortSignal that is already aborted when the expectation starts fails it at once with the signal's reason, for toBeVisible and toHaveURL alike. Strider has no signal: an expectation that is interrupted before it starts never runs, so nothing fails with a message to assert. The matrix row says Strider cancels by interruption, which has no counterpart of an already-aborted signal
A locator handler on a trigger that stays visible, with noWaitAfter, is run again every round, so the action never gets to its input
Differs, pending a decision: An expectation under a 1 ms deadline can't read the page once, so it fails with an empty history
